register.labelZh: FIGURE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: figure on 可以幫助你描述預計會發生的事情,以及出乎意料的情況。；當某人的行為或某事物令人難以理解時,可以使用 figure somebody/something out。；figure something out 可以表示計算數目、找出原因或想出做事的方法。；相同的英文字詞可以表示看透一個人、看懂某事物,或找出問題的答案。
register.summaryEn: FIGURE ON helps you describe what you expect to happen and situations that you did not expect. FIGURE SOMEBODY/SOMETHING OUT is useful when a person’s behaviour or something confusing is difficult to understand. FIGURE SOMETHING OUT can describe calculating a number, finding a cause or discovering a way to do something. The same words can describe understanding a person, understanding a thing or finding the answer to a problem.
